sentences.text: Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World

**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World" aims to promote mountaineering by providing financial aid to successful climbers, including up to ₹15,00,000 for those who scale Mt. Everest.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Sports & Culture; Sector: Sports

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World&quot; by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage and reward mountaineers who demonstrate extraordinary courage and determination by scaling some of the most difficult mountain peaks in the world. The scheme offers tiered financial assistance based on the height and difficulty of the peak climbed, ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹15,00,000, with the maximum incentive awarded to individuals who successfully scale Mt. Everest. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner, Youth Services and Cultural Activities, Gandhinagar.

**Benefits / Assistance:** > **Financial Support for Mountaineers:** - Financial assistance ranging from ₹50,000/- to ₹10,00,000/- is provided to individuals depending on the height and difficulty of the mountain scaled. - A maximum of ₹15,00,000/- is provided to those who successfully climb Mount Everest.

Application Process: Step 1: The interested applicant should download the prescribed format of the [application form](https://commi-synca.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Magazine/Document/1_216_3_revised-mount-everest-sahay-application-form-01092018.pdf). Step 2: In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the below mentioned address. Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. > Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department > Commissioner, Youth Services and Cultural Activities, Gujarat State, Block: 11, Third Floor, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan, Sector-10, > Gandhinagar, 382010. > Mobile: 079-23254095, 079-23252995 > Mail: commi-synca[at]gujarat[dot]gov[dot]in > Website: http://sycd.gujarat.gov.in
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Commissioner, Youth Services And Cultural Activities, Gandhinagar; Nodal Department: Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department
